headline: Bulgaria Sets Fines of Up to €100,000 for Unjustified Retail Price Hikes
summary: Retailers in Bulgaria risk fines reaching €100,000 per product if authorities determine price increases to be unjustified.
why: Government price enforcement measures impact retail margins, supplier contracts, and consumer inflation dynamics across European consumer markets.

impacts.name: Bulgarian Retail
impacts.why: Strict penalties for price adjustments increase compliance costs and limit pricing flexibility.
